title: A test-author spawned on a builder's round 3 of 3 runs the model its row says, so the table either names a step-up or says it stays on Haiku
why: Coordinator 00:51 CST Nov 14 (relayed from batch runner 12): on ios-adblock #167 round 3 the builder was refused by the test-edit guard, a test-author agent wrote the test, and its trailers show Haiku.
source: Coordinator message 00:51 CST Nov 14 (relayed; unread by the coordinator beyond the runner's message). Triage read docs/decisions/agent-model-cap.md on the stable checkout /root/claude-settings-main: row "test-author | haiku | xhigh"; the only try-3 row is the builder's ("builder, try 3 after a FAIL at review round 2 | opus"); line 12 names a builder's `Round 3 of 3` as the Opus cover. No past ruling or step on a test-author at round 3 (searched rulings and steps for test-author with third, try 3, round 3, opus).
note: Triage 00:53 CST Nov 14: by the table this is correct, not a spawn-path bug: a test-author stays on Haiku at every round; only the builder steps up. Whether a test-author at round 3 should run Sonnet (the ceiling) or Opus is policy, and Opus needs the owner's grant. Nothing is blocked by it (the #167 round runs). Parked as todo, no lane, no owner question yet; it becomes one when a round-3 test-author on Haiku causes a measured miss, or at the next table review. Unchecked by triage: the #167 trailers. Same family 01:05 CST Nov 14 (lane shared-savings-gap-read via the coordinator 01:03, relayed; no owner question): the lane's round 3 builder fix ran on Sonnet, not Opus, because the builder was resumed by name (rule roles-resume-by-name); the lane says so, against roles-third-round-steps-up. A resumed agent keeps its model, so a try 3 reached by resume stays below the step-up. Unchecked by triage whether the resume path can set the model.
